name: budgetrail-agent-app-example
description: Example AI agent app integrating BudgetRail V1 and V2 via the SDK. NOT published to npm.
_note: This example uses the SDK's public API surface — it imports only from @budgetrail/sdk,
never directly from contract ABI files or internal provider code.
The SDK itself is NOT yet published to npm (see packages/sdk/package.json).
To run: cd examples/agent-app && bun install && bun run simulate
For real onchain tests: set AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY in env and run bun run start -- --confirm
